Message:
KVM: s390: fix guest fprs memory leak

fprs is never freed, therefore resulting in a memory leak if
kvm_vcpu_init() fails or the vcpu is destroyed.

Fixes: 9977e886cbbc ("s390/kernel: lazy restore fpu registers")
